@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+Updated RPCs
+------------
+
+The no-op `includeWatching`, `include_watching`, and `include_watchonly`
+named options of `fundrawtransaction`, `walletcreatefundedpsbt`,
+`send`, `sendall`, and `simulaterawtransaction` are deprecated. They can only
+be passed when the RPC server is started with `-deprecatedrpc=watchonly` and
+will be removed in the next release. (#36855)
diff --git a/src/wallet/rpc/util.cpp b/src/wallet/rpc/util.cpp
index f8aee7d9d9..acd5b1921a 100644
--- a/src/wallet/rpc/util.cpp
+++ b/src/wallet/rpc/util.cpp
@@ -30,6 +30,16 @@ bool GetAvoidReuseFlag(const CWallet& wallet, const UniValue& param) {
     return avoid_reuse;
 }
 
+void CheckDeprecatedWatchonlyOption(const CWallet& wallet, const UniValue& options, const std::string& option_name)
+{
+    if (!options.exists(option_name)) return;
+    if (wallet.chain().rpcEnableDeprecated("watchonly")) return;
+    throw JSONRPCError(
+        RPC_METHOD_DEPRECATED,
+        "DEPRECATION WARNING: The `" + option_name + "` option, passed as a named argument or in the options object, is no longer used and will be removed in the next release. "
+        "To continue passing this deprecated no-op option, start the RPC server with `-deprecatedrpc=watchonly`.");
+}
